description: In a regular cardinal order of cofinality other than aleph zero, the diagonal intersection of clubs is club.
signature:
IsClub.diag.{v} {α : Type v} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] [IsRegularCardinalOrder α] {f : α → Set α}
  (hα : Order.cof α ≠ Cardinal.aleph0) (hf : ∀ (a : α), IsClub (f a)) : IsClub {a | ∀ b < a, a ∈ f b}
